title: Settled
summary: The Cult's boat ties up under the Drowned Abbey, with its markers on half of Saltmere aboard. Dace Pike's sister Wenna will burn it from her punt, if somebody holds the cloister above.

steps.journal: Hold the Drowned Abbey's cloister, on its first floor, for five waves while Wenna Pike fires the Cult's boat below.

ready: The Cult's boat is burning. Tell Dace Pike at the Drowned Eel in Saltmere.
done: The Cult's boat burned to the waterline while you held the cloister. Dace gave you Wren's ring, fished off it first.
